newsitem.title: UK: Aberdeen to acquire Prolific in 55.5 mln stg deal.
newsitem.headline: Aberdeen to acquire Prolific in 55.5 mln stg deal.

text.p: Aberdeen Asset Management Plc said on Thursday it had agreed to acquire Prolific Financial Management Plc from Scottish Provident Institution in an all-share deal worth 55.5 million stg.
The consideration is in the form of over 58 million new Aberdeen ordinary shares and gives Scottish Provident a holding of some 41 percent in international asset management group Aberdeen.
Prolific is the investment management business of Scottish Provident, the Edinburgh-based life assurer.

The acquisition will increase Aberdeen's funds under management from some 3.1 billion stg to around 11.0 billion. It is expected to be earnings enhancing in the first full year, before any exceptional items.
